HRS: archived aggregate estimates only; no HRS participant-level fitting
uniform_score: all five domains standardized using final eligible sample; grip standardized within sex; available-domain mean standardized again within cohort; ddof=1
missing_covariates: reuse archived 20 completed covariate datasets, no outcome imputation
domain_MI_scope: available outcome records with existing covariate imputations; does not refit domain-specific imputation models
benchmark_reproduction: PASS: CHARLS and ELSA estimates and SEs agree within 1e-8
uniform_three_cohort_pooling: NOT PERFORMED: uniform HRS estimate unavailable
ELSA_subpopulation_variance: All original household clusters and strata retained with zero contributions outside fitted subpopulation.
domain_BH_family: Five B-versus-A domain tests separately within each reanalysed cohort; not the original 10-test pooled family.
